Flow.description: F-08 trigger (b): an onboarding evidence field on the study changed (contract / budget / SSU / IRB / site readiness / SIV / CRIO / eSource / recruitment readiness / greenlight / activation…) — including the Internal Greenlight approval's field updates. Runs EM_Onboarding_Recalc, which auto-completes the matching tasks and advances the path. Not on create; honours Migration Mode.
Flow.label: EM Onboarding Program Sync
